evidence_legend.RF: literature-supported; see 'source' (keys R# in REFERENCES.md). 'RF-derived' in evidence_detail = computed by us from cited reference data (NIST SRD 126)
evidence_legend.ASSUMPTION: engineering placeholder; no direct literature value found in this review
evidence_legend.PK: (evidence_detail only) author prior knowledge not re-verified in this review

meta.how_to_use: Sample a per-object density uniformly or from a truncated normal within density_mgHA_cm3; apply sub-voxel microporosity as solid-fraction multiplier on dense-material density; build geometry at >=4x target voxel resolution, assign densities, then blur with PSF (FWHM 1.5-3 voxels, ASSUMPTION) and add correlated noise. Non-CaP materials must use energy_dependence_haeq for the declared effective energy.
caveats: Desktop microCT underestimates TMD by ~13-15% vs SRmicroCT; ash ~9-11% above SRmicroCT (R23).
Grey values are scanner/protocol-specific; morphometry differs across scanners by up to 236% for Tb.Th (R26).
Web-search budget was exhausted mid-review; several values are PK/ASSUMPTION and listed for verification in BONE_BIOLOGY_AND_GRAFTS.md section 5.

attenuation_tables.evidence_detail: RF-derived: NIST SRD 126 elemental mu/rho, log-log interpolation; ICRU-44 compositions; densities HA 3.16, b-TCP 3.07 (R32), CaSO4 2.96 (R59), CaSO4.2H2O 2.32 (PK), glass 2.70 (PK), Mg 1.74 (PK), Ti 4.51 (PK)
attenuation_tables.validation_point: SRmicroCT 25 keV: new bone ~3.8 /cm, BCP granules ~7.5 /cm, soft tissue/embedding ~1 /cm (R30); computed cortical bone 4.18 /cm, dense HA 11.06 /cm at 25 keV

air_void.relative_attenuation_note: mu~0; in an HA-in-water calibration air reads below zero: approx -190 (30 keV) to -440 (50 keV) mgHA/cm3 equivalent; includes H2 gas pockets from Mg corrosion
air_void.evidence_detail: RF-derived from R59 (calibration extrapolation); sizes ASSUMPTION

marrow_fatty.relative_attenuation_note: adipose ICRU-44 (0.95 g/cm3): -43 (30 keV) to -63 (80 keV)

marrow_soft_tissue.relative_attenuation_note: water/soft tissue ICRU-44: +13 (30 keV) to +48 (80 keV); indistinguishable from PMMA embedding and low-mineralized bone in histograms (R30)
marrow_soft_tissue.evidence_detail: RF-derived R59; R30 for PMMA overlap

fibrous_tissue.relative_attenuation_note: soft-tissue-like; untreated 8 mm rat calvarial defects contain thin fibrous tissue with only ~5-15% mineralized volume (R13)
fibrous_tissue.structure_size_um: membrane ~ calvarial thickness (~1000 um rat) (R13); thickness otherwise ASSUMPTION
fibrous_tissue.evidence_detail: density RF-derived (soft tissue); upper bound +60 ASSUMPTION for dense collagen

osteoid_unmineralized_matrix.relative_attenuation_note: unmineralized matrix ~ soft tissue; seam thickness O.Th per R6 nomenclature
osteoid_unmineralized_matrix.resorption: mineralizes after mineralization lag time Mlt (R6 definition)

cartilage_callus.relative_attenuation_note: hyaline cartilage ~ soft tissue; calcified cartilage would be intermediate (not quantified here)
cartilage_callus.resorption: soft callus removed during endochondral phase; day ~7-21 rodents (R45 figure timepoints day 3/14/21; ranges PK)
cartilage_callus.evidence_detail: density ASSUMPTION; biology RF R45, R47

cortical_host_bone.relative_attenuation_note: ICRU cortical bone 1.92 g/cm3 -> 1100 (30 keV) to 1217 (80 keV) HA-eq; desktop microCT reads ~13-15% below SRmicroCT; ash-referenced bone 1250-1300
cortical_host_bone.structure_size_um: rat calvaria ~1000 thick (R13); mouse femoral Ct.Th ~150-250 (PK)
cortical_host_bone.evidence_detail: RF R23 (human trabecular tissue 940-1030 desktop, 1150 SR, 1250-1300 ash), RF-derived R59; upper/lower bounds widened as ASSUMPTION

trabecular_host_bone.relative_attenuation_note: tissue TMD by desktop microCT 940-1030 (human, Scanco uCT40 70 kV); thin trabeculae read lower due to PVE

BV/TV_fraction.other_species: PK 0.08-0.45 depending on site; BV/TV ~ size-independent (R54)

trabecular_host_bone.evidence_detail: mouse values RF (R26,R7); allometric RF-derived (R54: Tb.Th ~ Mb^0.155 anchored 0.052 mm @5 g, 0.511 mm @3400 kg); rat/rabbit/sheep/human measured ranges PK

woven_bone_early.relative_attenuation_note: early (<=2-4 wk) mineralizing woven bone; spans below and above the Scanco callus threshold of 641.9 mgHA/cm3 (=~45% cortical attenuation, R21); in SRmicroCT forms a poorly defined peak between embedding and bone (R30)
woven_bone_early.resorption: remodelled to lamellar bone over weeks-months (R58 stages; timing PK)
woven_bone_early.evidence_detail: range ASSUMPTION anchored to R21 threshold and R30 histogram description

woven_bone_mid.relative_attenuation_note: 4-8 wk; maturing; TMD rises over healing time (R8, R21)

new_bone_late_remodelled.relative_attenuation_note: >=12 wk; approaches host trabecular TMD; indistinguishable from host bone and allograft by intensity
new_bone_late_remodelled.evidence_detail: anchored to R23 host tissue values

HA_sintered_dense.relative_attenuation_note: chemically bone-mineral-like: energy-independent HA-eq; dense = 3160 (~2.8x cortical bone); radiopaque, 'as high as cortical bone' for granules and can inflate BMD/BV/TV (R31)

resorption.timescale: years; 'often remain in the body for several years' (R32)
resorption.model_suggestion: residual fraction ~1.0 over study (<=5%/yr loss; ASSUMPTION)

HA_sintered_dense.separability: EASY early and late except edge halo
HA_sintered_dense.evidence_detail: density R32; HA-eq RF-derived R59; sizes PK/ASSUMPTION except pore >300 um recommendation R44

HA_microporous_or_nanocrystalline.relative_attenuation_note: apparent HA-eq = solid fraction x 3160; at 0.3-0.6 solid fraction overlaps mature bone

resorption.timescale: slow; minipig HA-SiO filler 34.5% (2 wk) -> 31.2% (8 wk) (R41)

HA_microporous_or_nanocrystalline.evidence_detail: solid-fraction range ASSUMPTION; resorption RF R41

beta_TCP.relative_attenuation_note: HA-eq of dense b-TCP 3020-3030 (~96% of HA), energy-independent; porous/resorbing granules fall into bone range

resorption.model_suggestion: exponential residual with half-life 3-12 months in rodents/rabbits, with surface erosion + increasing microporosity (ASSUMPTION)

beta_TCP.evidence_detail: density/solubility R32; resorption R32,R33; sizes PK; kinetics model ASSUMPTION

composition_examples: easy-graft HA/TCP granules ~600 um with PLA coating (R30)
BCP_HA_TCP.relative_attenuation_note: SRmicroCT 25 keV: BCP ~7.5 /cm vs new bone ~3.8 /cm vs soft tissue ~1 /cm (R30) -> ~2x bone

resorption.mechanism: b-TCP phase preferentially resorbed; rate depends on HA/TCP ratio (R32, R35)
resorption.timescale: minipig BCP60/40 filler 23.6% at 2 and 8 wk (R41); months-years
resorption.model_suggestion: TCP fraction decays as beta_TCP, HA fraction persists (ASSUMPTION)

BCP_HA_TCP.separability: EASY intact; HARD when degrading (overlaps preliminary bone, R30)
BCP_HA_TCP.evidence_detail: R30 measured attenuation; granule sizes partly PK

calcium_sulfate.relative_attenuation_note: HA-eq rises with energy (S content); porous/dissolving fronts drop into bone range
calcium_sulfate.evidence_detail: qualitative resorption RF R36; weeks PK

resorption.mechanism: ion exchange -> silica gel -> HCA layer; bonds to bone (R37, R38)
resorption.model_suggestion: core shrinks; add 10-50 um Ca-P rim at ~bone density (ASSUMPTION)

DBM.relative_attenuation_note: demineralized (0.5-0.6 N HCl); residual mineral 1-6% -> near soft tissue; carriers (glycerol, hyaluronate, CMC, poloxamer) radiolucent; calcium sulfate carrier adds density
DBM.evidence_detail: composition/size RF R39; HA-eq range RF-derived assuming residual mineral fraction; upper 100 ASSUMPTION

allograft_mineralized.evidence_detail: density by identity with host bone (R23); sizes PK

resorption.timescale: rapid substitution: minipig filler 17.1% (2 wk) -> 9.3% (8 wk) (R41)

DBBM_xenograft_BioOss.relative_attenuation_note: deproteinized bone mineral; 'similar gray values' to new bone, granule borders misclassified as bone (R14)

resorption.timescale: essentially non-resorbing: no change in particle size 6 mo -> 11 yr; 17.3% DBBM at 11 yr (R40); minipig 35.7% -> 31.6% (2-8 wk) (R41)

DBBM_xenograft_BioOss.separability: UNDERDETERMINED by intensity; recoverable with day-0 registration
DBBM_xenograft_BioOss.evidence_detail: intensity similarity RF R14 (qualitative); numeric range = host bone range (ASSUMPTION by physical reasoning)

sintered_bovine_HA_cerabone.relative_attenuation_note: sintered at 1250 C (R14); possibly denser than DBBM (PK)

composite_polymer_CaP.relative_attenuation_note: effective HA-eq ~ ceramic volume fraction x 3030 (b-TCP) or 3160 (HA); e.g. 20 vol% -> ~600 (woven-bone band); polymer ~ soft tissue

resorption.timescale: polymer PLGA weeks-months, PCL 2-4 yr (PK); ceramic as above

composite_polymer_CaP.evidence_detail: mixing rule RF-derived; volume fractions ASSUMPTION

Mg_alloy.relative_attenuation_note: pure Mg 628 (30 keV) -> 776 (80 keV) HA-eq: inside woven-bone band; rare-earth alloys higher (PK)

resorption.mechanism: corrosion; alloy-dependent; corrosion layer accumulates biological Ca-P; increased bone mass around rods (R42)

Mg_alloy.evidence_detail: HA-eq RF-derived; corrosion biology RF R42, R43; densities PK

titanium_fixation.relative_attenuation_note: far above calibration range; streak/beam-hardening artifacts

scanner_personalities.note: For harmonization training; parameters are ASSUMPTION unless stated
scanner_personalities.psf_reference: SRmicroCT 10% MTF = 4.37 um at 2.17 um pixel (R30)
scanner_personalities.bh_reference: desktop vs SR TMD -12.9 to -15% (R23); BH artifacts up to 32.6% (R24); BH-correction choice changes TMD 4.7-9.7% (R21, R23)
